def transform(g):
    h=len(g)
    # find separator rows (uniform, repeated values different from background?) - rows of 0s here
    seps=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]==0]
    if not seps: return g
    last=seps[-1]

    prev=max([s for s in seps if s<last], default=-1)

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h=len(g)
    vals=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seps=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg]
    if not seps: return g
    last=seps[-1]
    prev=max([s for s in seps if s<last], default=-1)
    unit=g[prev+1:last+1]
    p=len(unit)
    return [unit[i%p] for i in range(h)]

print(transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
out=transform(test)
print(json.dumps(out))
